0022600210.text: The Warriors (6-3, 4-1 at home) host the Pelicans (4-5) on a six-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Pacific and 8th in the West, while New Orleans is 5th in the Southwest and 11th in the West and has lost its last game. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness) and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though their last meeting was a 113-109 loss in New Orleans on February 24, 2026.
